title: Flow
description: What a person is walked through to define one kind of manifest: the steps, in order, and the fields each step asks for. Every interface renders a flow from this description, so a web screen and a terminal screen ask the same questions in the same order with the same words. A field is addressed by its path in the manifest (a JSON pointer), which is also how a check names the field it is about and how the conformance driver finds it.

id.description: The flow's id; one flow per manifest kind, named after it in lower case.

name.description: The standard noun for what is being defined, in the organisation's words via Settings when they differ.

for.description: The manifest kind this flow defines.

review.description: Whether the flow ends with a review step showing everything gathered before a version is saved.

key.description: Stable identifier; what a check's fix link and a driver's Step() name.

title.description: The standard term for the step (Aim, Measures, Scope), never a chatty paraphrase.

guide.description: One spoken sentence saying what the step settles, plain idea first.

path.description: JSON pointer into the manifest; the schema at that path says the type, the enum, the reference target and the title.

control.description: How the field is asked for. choice: pick one of the schema's enum; reference: pick an existing manifest of the x-cartograph-ref kind, with a way to add one; references: pick several; list: a keyed list of items, each defined by the fields below; horizon: years and optional months with a 'same as above' choice.

title.description: Overrides the schema's title for this step only; otherwise the schema's title is the label.

hint.description: One spoken sentence shown while the field is empty. Never a placeholder inside the control.

key.description: For a list: the item property that identifies an item (the schema's x-cartograph-list-key). Items are merged by this key across editors.

fields.description: For a list: the fields of one item, paths relative to the item.

checks.description: Keys of the checks this field answers (SMART marks, completeness lines); shown beside the field as marks, never as prose.
